class BytesIOCopy(io.BufferedRandom):
    """A stream backed by a real temporary file (so it has a working
    ``fileno()``, unlike :class:`io.BytesIO`) that also copies everything
    written to it to another stream.

    .. versionadded:: 8.2
    """

    def __init__(self, copy_to: io.BytesIO) -> None:
        super().__init__(t.cast("t.BinaryIO", tempfile.TemporaryFile()))
        self.copy_to = copy_to

    def flush(self) -> None:
        super().flush()
        self.copy_to.flush()

    def write(self, b: ReadableBuffer) -> int:
        self.copy_to.write(b)
        return super().write(b)

    def getvalue(self) -> bytes:
        pos = self.tell()
        self.flush()
        self.seek(0)
        data = self.read()
        self.seek(pos)
        return data

    def __init__(self, copy_to: io.BytesIO) -> None:
        super().__init__(t.cast("t.BinaryIO", tempfile.TemporaryFile()))
        self.copy_to = copy_to

    def flush(self) -> None:
        super().flush()
        self.copy_to.flush()

    def write(self, b: ReadableBuffer) -> int:
        self.copy_to.write(b)
